game.name: Sega Superstars Tennis (World)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Sega Superstars Tennis on Xbox 360 brings together all of Sega's stars on tennis courts inspired by their worlds. The player can choose between 16 characters, from Sonic to NiGHTS and Dr. Eggman. Essentially intended for multiplayer use (online play, tournaments, mini-games...), this title uses the basics of arcade games for a very basic and immediate grasp.
